objective: Describe measured context differences that coarse consumption types absorb; compare peers by consumption and municipal context without inferring production function.
question: At the same number of groups, how do size, accessibility, covered-organization wages and structure change the peer set of municipalities with similar spending?

blocks.context6: Six blocks, weights1/6; median pair squared distance equals block weight after transformation.
blocks.spending2: Same IDs; level and CLR blocks, weights1/2.
blocks.meaning: Equal nominal/typical-distance block weights do not imply equal contribution to every pair or statistical independence.

preprocessing.constant_scale: explicit task failure; do not silently omit a block

must_freeze: matched draw ID arrays for all K and variants
execution_contract_boundary.proposed_bounded_design: Deterministic Lloyd/k-means++ Euclidean fits,8 initializations/full and per draw;20 matched80-percent draws;7Kx2variantsx21supports=294 chosen partitions/2352 starts. This is a proposal until separate executable registration pins exact seeds/draws and resource envelope; no outcomes may be consulted in choosing them.

mandatory_profiles: monthly spending profile and annual aggregation definition
representative IDs chosen by declared centroid-distance rule
draw-based membership/stability uncertainty with preprocessing rebuilt
interpretation_and_evaluation.stability: ARI on common IDs plus per-full-group matched Jaccard distributions and recovery frequency; keep tiny/unmatched groups visible. Small N alone is not automatic rejection.
interpretation_and_evaluation.within_K_comparison: Matched support/draws/seeds and algorithm budget for both variants; report how peer sets/partitions and raw profiles change.
interpretation_and_evaluation.across_geometry: Do not directly rank context6 against spending2 by inertia, SW or its own silhouette; metrics refer to different geometries. Any common-space score must name its geometry.
interpretation_and_evaluation.across_K: No SW-only winner or best-looking month/K. Report fixed full grid and resolution-stability-size tradeoff; no automatic promotion of a single best K.
interpretation_and_evaluation.K2_crosswalk: Descriptive only on exact common IDs: existing December K2 and annual2024 context represent different periods/geometries.
interpretation_and_evaluation.external_validation: No independent unused outcome frozen in this stage. Salary, workers, education, population and access are training context, not held-out validation.
interpretation_and_evaluation.names: Neutral measured profiles; do not infer industrial/tourist/budget/production functions from education share or spending alone.

acceptance.usable_additional_typology: All registered completed partitions auditable; profiles/stability/coverage honestly disclosed; useful peer differences described in measured terms. No guaranteed scientific improvement before fitting.
data_no_go: independent external validation claim for included X

scientific_limitations: Retrospective processed data release2025-09-18 for reference2024; upstream original row publication dates unknown.
Unknown upstream reuse in modelled consumption; not fully independent measurement families.
Population stock Jan1_2024 differs from annual average workforce; intensity is a stock-denominator proxy, not resident employment.
Market access already contains population context; related blocks are not independent.
Selected CLR5 categories do not sum to Total; no invented residual category.
Unweighted municipality fitting describes municipalities rather than a population-weighted welfare distribution.
All months2024 used; no attractive-month selection; annual aggregation hides seasonality, raw monthly arrays retained.
